text.p: Tropical Cyclone Josie, with 55 mph winds, is in the northern Mozambique Channel near 14.5s/45.0e, moving west southwest at 11 mph. Josie is expected to intensify to 75 mph during th enext 36 hours, turning more southward in the Mozambique Channel between Mozambique and Madagascar. The threat this period will be mainly to shipping.
Strong westerly winds in northwestern Europe may result in local wind damage. Shipping in the North Sea and English Channel will also be under risk.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS
